en: Training's been kind of rough lately.
What do you think, Coach?
You're doing great. Just hang in a bit longer.
If it's too much, I'll ease up the intensity.
A pro should be able to take it.

ko: 네… 감독님 말 믿고 버텨 볼게요.
en: Okay… I'll trust you and push through.
Easy for you to say.

ko: 정말요? 그럼 조금 숨 돌릴 수 있겠네요.
en: Really? Then I can finally catch my breath.
…You're right. I'll keep at it.
Understood. (Their face hardens.)
Coach, do you have a minute?

ko: 지난 경기 제 플레이 어땠는지 궁금해서요.
en: I wanted to know how I played last match.
You were composed. Keep it up.

ko: 몇 군데 아쉬웠어. 같이 영상 보자.
en: A few spots could be better. Let's watch the VOD together.
Let your results do the talking.
Phew. I'll keep doing it that way.
You'll watch it with me? Awesome!

ko: 네… 지적만 듣는 건 좀 힘드네요.
en: Okay… just getting criticized is kind of hard.
…Okay.

ko: *{name} 선수가 숙소 거실에 혼자 앉아 창밖을 보고 있다.
en: *{name} is sitting alone in the dorm living room, staring out the window.
I've just had a lot on my mind lately.

ko: 무슨 일 있어? 천천히 말해 봐.
en: Something wrong? Take your time.
Managing your condition is part of the job.
Let's talk tomorrow. Get some rest tonight.
Thanks for listening. I feel a lot better.
It's nothing. I guess I'm just tired.
Yeah. I know.
Got it, Coach. I'll get a good night's sleep.
This stays between us, okay?

ko: 저 이번 시즌에 꼭 우승하고 싶어요.
en: I really want to win it all this season.
Let's do it together. I feel the same way.
Ambition's good, but one step at a time.
Great. I'll show you next match!
One step at a time… got it.
…You called for me?
*{name} avoids your eyes.
Just checking how you've been.

ko: 내가 뭐 서운하게 한 거 있어?
en: Did I do something to upset you?
Your attitude in practice has been a bit off.
Same as always.
…Actually, there was something. Can I tell you?
No. I'm fine.
…I'll fix it.
(No answer.)
Yesterday's match… that was on me.
I threw the teamfight.
It's a team game. Don't carry it alone.
So what are you going to do next time?
Coach… thank you.
Still, it was my fault.

ko: 교전 각을 다시 볼게요. 다음엔 안 놓쳐요.
en: I'll rework my engage angles. I won't miss it next time.
We won last match!
Can we take it easy tonight?
Take the night off. Well played.
Winning is when you tighten things up.
That's our coach!
…Fair. I'll start with the review.
Can't even rest after a win…
You're always so calm, Coach.
I want to be like that too.

ko: 루틴을 지키면 돼. 같이 짜 볼까?
en: Just stick to a routine. Want to build one together?
I'm nervous inside too.
A routine? Sounds good, I'll give it a shot.
You too? That's surprising.

ko: 감독님 현역 때 얘기 해 주세요!
en: Tell me about your pro days, Coach!
Did you practice this hard back then?
Harder. Fourteen hours a day.
I didn't know any better back then. You're all better than I was.
Whoa… then I can't lose either!
Isn't that a bit much…?
Hearing you say that really fires me up.
*You went to the snack bar outside the dorm with {name}.
The tteokbokki here is seriously good.

ko: 감독님이랑 밖에서 밥 먹는 거 처음이에요.
en: This is the first time I've eaten out with you, Coach.
Let's come here more often.
Enjoy. It's on me tonight.
Really? That's a promise!
Thanks for the meal!
*You went to the arcade with {name}.

ko: 감독님 현역 때 실력 보여 주세요!
en: Show me what you had back in your pro days, Coach!
*The result: a razor-thin win for the coach.
Still got it, huh?
I went easy on you. Next time, for real.
Respect. You're actually really good.
Next time I'm winning!
*You walked along the Han River with {name}.
Nice breeze…

ko: 사실 프로 되기 전엔 여기 자주 왔어요.
en: Actually, I used to come here a lot before I went pro.
What were you thinking about back then?
And how about now?
That I wanted to stand on that stage someday… that's all.
Now… I'm happy. For real.
*A small theater {name} picked out.

ko: 이 영화 꼭 같이 보고 싶었어요.
en: I really wanted to watch this movie with you.
*After the movie, neither of you says anything for a while.
That was a good movie.
You cried, didn't you?
Right? I knew it'd be your kind of movie.
Wh-what? No, I didn't!
*A beach near {name}'s hometown.

ko: 여기서 처음 게임 시작했어요. 저 PC방이요.
en: This is where I started gaming. That PC bang right there.
*The sign is worn out, but the lights are still on.
So this is where it all started.
Want to go in?
Yeah. All thanks to you, Coach.
For real? The owner's going to freak out!

ko: *늦은 밤 옥상. {name} 선수가 먼저 와 있었다.
en: *The rooftop, late at night. {name} got there first.

ko: 감독님. 저 이번 시즌 끝나면 꼭 하고 싶은 말이 있어요.
en: Coach. There's something I really want to tell you when this season's over.
…Saying it now would be cheating, so I'll tell you after we win.
Then we'd better win.
I'll be waiting.
It's a promise.
Yeah. For sure.
@Injury
*During practice, {name} grabbed their wrist.
I'm fine… it's just a little sore.
We're going to the hospital now. Skip practice.
Tape it up and get through today.
Okay… I'll heal up fast.
Huh, it's better than I thought.
Ow… it hurts even more now.
@Slump

ko: *{name} 선수의 연습 경기 성적이 며칠째 바닥이다.
en: *{name}'s scrim results have been rock bottom for days.
…Nothing I do works.
Let's just do fundamentals for a few days.
Keep doing what you do. It'll come back.
I might open up your spot for competition.
Back to basics… I'll try.
And if that doesn't work either?
Okay. I'll trust you.
…I'm not going to lose.
Did you really have to go that far?
@Conflict
*Voices are raised in the practice room. {name} is right in the middle of it.
Nobody listens to my calls!
Let's all sit down and talk this out.
{name} is right. Follow the calls.
Both of you, knock it off. Just practice.
…Fine. I'll try talking.
Talking won't change anything.
Thank you.
(A door slams.)
@Homesick

ko: *{name} 선수가 밤늦게 가족과 통화하며 울고 있었다.
en: *{name} was crying on the phone with family late at night.

ko: 집에 한 번만 다녀오면 안 될까요?
en: Could I go home just once?
Go for a day. Don't worry about practice.
I'll make sure you go once the season's over.
Thank you, Coach!
…Okay. That's a promise.
Got it.
@Hate Comments
*The community boards are flooded with posts targeting {name}.
I don't care. …I'm trying not to.
I'll hold on to your phone for a while.
Let's put out an official team statement.
Just prove them wrong with your play.
Honestly, that's kind of a relief.
This is so frustrating…
You're going to stand up for me?
Just watch me.
If it were that easy, I wouldn't be like this.
@Late

ko: *{name} 선수가 오전 훈련에 한 시간 늦었다.
en: *{name} was an hour late to morning practice.
I'm sorry! I didn't hear my alarm.
That's a fine. Rules are rules.
Be careful next time.
Did something happen?
…Okay. I'll pay it.
Thank you!

ko: 사실 요즘 잠을 잘 못 자요.
en: Actually, I haven't been sleeping well lately.
I just overslept.
@Gear Failure
*The match gear died in the middle of practice.
I'm used to this one, I don't want to switch…
Let's get used to new gear right away.
Let's rush-order the same model.
Huh, this is better than I expected?
It just doesn't feel right in my hands…
Phew, thank goodness…!
@{tx_576HKVWRTP}

ko: 이번 주도 시간 내주셔서 감사합니다 감독님.
en: Thanks for making time for us again this week, Coach.

ko: 지난주 훈련 성과가 눈에 띄더군요. 이번 주 계획도 비슷하게 가시나요?
en: Last week's training results really stood out. Are you sticking with a similar plan this week?
We're going according to plan. No reason to waver.

ko: 조금 바꿀 생각입니다. 아직 말씀드리긴 이르고요.
en: I'm thinking of changing a few things. Too early to say, though.
You'll see on the stage.
@{tx_J8VCATJ5GB}

ko: 주말 경기 상대가 만만치 않다는 평이 많습니다.
en: Many say this weekend's opponent is a tough one.
Honestly, are you confident you can win?
I believe in my players.
It won't be easy, but we've prepared something.
That's a bit of a rude question.
@{tx_MH87R5EDPY}
How's the mood in the team?
There have been rumors of friction.
We're like a family.
There's competition, but it's healthy competition.
I won't respond to baseless rumors.
@{tx_J8VCATJ5GB}

ko: 지난 경기 패배 원인을 어떻게 보십니까?
en: What do you see as the cause of last match's loss?
I didn't prepare enough.
The players weren't in good shape.
I've already forgotten about that match.
@{tx_576HKVWRTP}
{name} was the MVP of the last match.
Any words of praise?
{name} is the backbone of this team.
One good match isn't enough.
That MVP belongs to the whole team.
@{tx_MH87R5EDPY}
There are rumors {name} is transferring overseas.
Is it true?
{name} is with us to the end.
Why don't you ask the player?
@{tx_J8VCATJ5GB}
Word is {name} struggled in the last match.
Are you considering a substitution?
Not at all. I believe in {name}.
I'll decide based on their condition.
They did struggle, that's a fact.
@{tx_576HKVWRTP}

ko: 팬들 사이에서 {name} 선수 비판 여론이 있습니다.
en: There's been criticism of {name} among the fans.
I'll take the criticism.
That's something the player has to overcome.
@{tx_MH87R5EDPY}
Your signature macro style is the talk of the scene.
What's the secret?
Thorough preparation, that's all.
It's thanks to the players following through.
@{tx_J8VCATJ5GB}

ko: 현역 시절과 지금 중 언제가 더 떨립니까?
en: Which is more nerve-racking: your playing days or now?
Now. Because it's my players' match.
My playing days. Now I just enjoy it.

*The practice room after training. {name} is wiping off sweat.
>How was training today?

ko: 그럭저럭이요. 손은 좀 풀린 것 같아요.
en: So-so. I think my hands loosened up a bit.

ko: 그 정도면 충분해. 오늘은 푹 쉬어.
en: That's enough. Get some proper rest today.
Okay, thank you.
Let's push a little harder tomorrow.
Sounds good. I was thinking the same.
...Okay. I'll try.

ko: 감독님! 오늘 확실히 늘었어요. 느낌이 와요.
en: Coach! I definitely got better today. I can feel it.
>I saw it too. Your movement was different.

ko: 이 감각 잊지 말고 계속 가자.
en: Hold on to that feeling and keep going.
Yes! I hope tomorrow goes just like this.

ko: 들뜨지 마. 아직 갈 길이 멀어.
en: Don't get carried away. There's a long way to go.
...You're right. I'll stay focused.

ko: 칭찬 한 번 듣기가 이렇게 어렵네요.
en: Getting one compliment out of you is so hard.
I worked hard, but it feels like I'm going nowhere.
*There's no strength in {name}'s voice.

ko: 쌓이고 있는 거야. 결과는 나중에 와.
en: It's adding up. Results come later.
...I'll trust you on that.
You say that every time.

ko: 방법을 바꿔 보자. 같이 고민해 줄게.
en: Let's change the approach. I'll think it through with you.

ko: 정말요? 그럼 내일 영상 같이 봐 주세요.
en: Really? Then please review the footage with me tomorrow.
Everyone goes through it. Let's move on.
...Okay.

ko: *{name}{i} 의자에 등을 기댄 채 눈을 감고 있다.
en: *{name} sits leaning back in the chair, eyes closed.
Sorry, just let me stay like this a little.
It's fine. Let's call it a day.
...Thank you, Coach.

ko: 힘든 거 알아. 그래도 조금만 더 버텨.
en: I know it's hard. Hang in there a little longer.
Yes... I'll hang in there.
I'm really at my limit right now.

ko: 전장 훈련은 늘 같은 동선이라 좀 지루해요.
en: Field drills are always the same routes, it gets a bit dull.

ko: >지루한 게 몸에 배야 실전에서 안 흔들려.
en: >It has to get dull enough to stick, so you don't waver in a real match.
Want to mix in some unusual routes tomorrow?
Oh, that sounds fun!
Basics matter most. Keep it as is.
Got it. I'll nail the basics first.
Yeah... right.

ko: 교전 훈련, 오늘은 반응이 계속 반 박자 늦었어요.
en: Engage drills today, I kept reacting half a beat late.
From where I stood, your decisions were good.
Really? That's a bit of a relief.
Let's work out together why you were late.

ko: 아, 시야를 너무 좁게 봤던 거군요.
en: Ah, I was keeping my view too narrow.
Hmm... I'm not sure.

ko: 메크랑 조금씩 호흡이 맞아 가는 것 같아요.
en: I think the mech and I are slowly getting in sync.

ko: 좋아. 그 메크로 다음 경기 준비하자.
en: Good. Let's prepare the next match with that mech.
Yes! Look forward to it.
Don't get too tied to one mech.
Got it. I'll try the others too.
*Fresh from joint training, {name} and {name2} come over together.

ko: 오늘 {name2}랑 합 맞춰 봤는데 꽤 괜찮았어요.
en: I synced up with {name2} today, and it went pretty well.
&Thanks to me backing you up.

ko: 둘 다 잘했어. 그 호흡 그대로 가자.
en: You both did well. Keep that rhythm.
Hear that? Even the coach approves.
&Next time I'll take the lead.

ko: 아직 부족해. 내일 한 번 더 맞춰 봐.
en: Not there yet. Sync up once more tomorrow.
&Okay, we'll sync up even more tomorrow.
...The two of us again?
&Coach, {name} got a lot better today.

ko: 야, 그런 말을 왜 네가 해.
en: Hey, why are you the one saying that.

ko: 서로 끌어 주는 게 보기 좋다.
en: It's good to see you pulling each other up.
&Hehe, we're a team.
{name2}, you can't fall behind either, right?
&Of course. Tomorrow's my turn.
&...Saying that puts pressure on me.
*{name2} pats a worn-out {name} on the shoulder.

ko: &얘 오늘 무리했어요. 좀 쉬게 해 주세요.
en: &They overdid it today. Please let them rest.
Both of you, head in early today.
...Thank you.
{name2}, look after them today.
&Leave it to me.
&Honestly I'm a bit worn out too.

en: {name} trust Lv.{n}
